Formula: 1.1.1 (ANC within 1st trimester) / 1.1 ((NEW) PW ANC registered) x 100
Caveats: denominator is (NEW) PW ANC registered; 1.1 label gains 'NEW' from 2023-24

Formula: (1.2.2 TT2/Td2 + 1.2.3 TT/Td Booster) / 1.1 ((NEW) PW ANC registered) x 100 - possible double-count for women given both doses
Caveats: possible double-count between 1.2.2 and 1.2.3; values may legitimately exceed 100

Formula: 1.4.3 (Hb<7 old schema / Hb<=7 new schema) / 1.4.2 (Hb<11) x 100 - definition changed across schema; recent-HMIS indicator only
Comparator: recent-HMIS indicator (not comparable to legacy 2008-2019 feature)

Formula: 5.1 (aggregate obstetric complications attended) / (home SBA + home non-SBA + institutional deliveries) x 100; available 2020-21 .. 2022-23 only
Caveats: 2020-2021..2022-2023 only; numerator 5.1 attended cases; denominator is home SBA + home non-SBA + institutional deliveries
